name: Ninja Clan Leader
body:
The clan leader guides other ninja rather than doing the dirty work themselves.

Deshi (Ex)

At 1st level, a clan leader gains a special cohort called their deshi. The deshi begins as a 1st level warrior except they also have a 1d6 sneak attack. The deshi does not level up until the clan leader’s 3rd level.

At 3rd level, the deshi may swap out their warrior level for a level in ninja. The deshi cannot multi-class until the clan leader’s 7th level. A clan leader also starts gaining followers as if they have the Leadership feat.

However, all of their followers must be warriors or ninjas.

At 7th level, this transforms into full Leadership as a bonus feat. This includes allowing for more diverse followers. However, their deshi must have levels in ninja equal to at least half of their total levels.

This ability replaces all instances of sneak attack.
